Conventional platforms reject you. This is not a problem to workaround. It’s a sovereign commerce stack — owned, deployed, and controlled by you. No subscriptions. No platforms. No middlemen. This guide walks you through deploying a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-explained-digital-creators-stripe-4|bitcoin]]-enabled ebook store using free tools and open infrastructure. By the end, you’ll have a live store that accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies, delivers products instantly, and stores your data securely — all without depending on any single company. This is how you build commerce infrastructure that cannot be blocked, restricted, or revoked.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms fail because they are centralized. They rely on single points of control — payment processors, hosting providers, email services. When one fails or rejects you, your business stops. Sovereign infrastructure removes these dependencies. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages — free, globally distributed hosting. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script — serverless, scalable. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets — owned by you. File delivery is managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 — instant, secure. Payments are processed by NOWPayments — 0.5% fee, no KYC, automatic on-chain verification. This architecture is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. You own every component. No platform can revoke your access. No subscription can expire. This is how you build a store that operates on your terms, not Stripe’s.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your assets. First, your digital product — ebook, course, template. Ensure it’s in a deliverable format (PDF, ZIP, etc.). Second, a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting. Third, a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Sign up at NOWPayments.io — no KYC required. Fourth, a domain (optional but recommended). Use your existing domain or register a new one. Fifth, basic familiarity with GitHub or Cloudflare dashboards. If you’re new, spend 30 minutes exploring their interfaces. Sixth, your product pricing in USD. NOWPayments converts this to Bitcoin or any of 300+ cryptocurrencies at transaction time. Finally, decide your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack for simplicity or Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates if you plan to deploy multiple stacks. This preparation ensures a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with payment processing. Log in to NOWPayments, create a new API key, and configure your webhook URL. This URL will receive payment confirmation and trigger product delivery. For delivery, set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Upload your product files and generate shareable links. These links will be sent to buyers post-payment. Next, deploy your backend logic. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the process: payment confirmation → order storage → file delivery. For order storage, configure Supabase or Google Sheets. Each transaction will be logged here for your records. Test the pipeline end-to-end before going live. Send a test payment, verify the webhook fires, and ensure the product is delivered. This pipeline is your store’s backbone — automated, secure, and owned by you.
Your store runs on infrastructure you own — no platforms, no subscriptions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Connect your domain if using one. Ensure your backend logic is live and linked to your frontend. Share your store URL with your audience. When a buyer purchases your ebook, NOWPayments processes the payment. The moment the transaction confirms on-chain, the webhook fires. Your backend logic logs the order and sends the product delivery link to the buyer’s email. Monitor your first transactions closely. Check order logs in Supabase or Google Sheets. Verify product delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This is your store operating — no platform involvement, no middlemen, no delays. Your infrastructure is live, and your first Bitcoin transaction is processed.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Your store is live. Now scale it. Add more products by uploading files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and updating your backend logic. Expand payment options by enabling additional cryptocurrencies in NOWPayments. Optimize delivery speed by configuring CDN settings in Cloudflare. Enhance security by setting up SPF/DKIM/DMARC for your email domain. Monitor performance using Cloudflare analytics or Google Sheets logs. As your store grows, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features like multi-product support and end-to-end testing. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates for seamless scaling. This infrastructure is not static — it grows with you. No platform limits. No subscription caps. You control the scale.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To accept Bitcoin for ebook sales without Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This infrastructure automates payment verification, order logging, and product delivery — all without relying on centralized platforms. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates for a seamless deployment.
Accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with 0.5% fees and no KYC requirements.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Prepare your digital product (ebook, course, etc.) in deliverable format. 2. Create accounts on GitHub/Cloudflare and NOWPayments. 3. Configure NOWPayments API key and webhook URL. 4. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Deploy backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 6. Set up order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 7. Test the payment and delivery pipeline end-to-end. 8. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 9. Share your store URL and process your first Bitcoin transaction. 10. Monitor performance and scale infrastructure as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies?
Yes. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Enable any coin in your dashboard, and buyers can pay with their preferred currency. Fees remain 0.5% regardless of the coin.
Do I need a domain to deploy this store?
No, but it’s recommended. You can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages’ free subdomains. A custom domain enhances professionalism and trust.
How are product delivery links secured?
Delivery links are generated dynamically and sent only after payment confirmation. Use Cloudflare R2’s private links or Google Drive’s restricted access for added security.
What if a buyer’s payment fails?
NOWPayments automatically retries failed transactions. If the payment cannot be confirmed, no delivery link is sent. You retain full control over order fulfillment.
Can I upgrade my stack later?
Yes. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack and upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack as your store grows. The Complete Builder Kit includes all blueprints for seamless upgrades.
